OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.

      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0

## What I did

The spec: on `POST /api/owners`, when no `registrationDate` is supplied, default it to the server's current date; the field round-trips back through `GET` in ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

**Changes (minimal, low structural impact):**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added an optional `registrationDate` field (`type: string, format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. The generator maps `format: date` → `LocalDate`, so both `OwnerFieldsDto` (request) and `OwnerDto` (response) get the field automatically, and MapStruct maps it by name in both directions with no mapper edits.

2. **`Owner.java`** — added the `registrationDate` (`LocalDate`) column with a getter/setter, so it persists and survives the create→read round trip.

3. **`BuildOwner.java`** — the single existing create step now defaults the date in place: `if (owner.getRegistrationDate() == null) owner.setRegistrationDate(LocalDate.now());`. Folding the default into this one-method class avoided adding a new pipeline function *and* a new YAML step.

4. **DB schemas** — added a `registration_date DATE` column to all four `schema.sql` files. Only `hsqldb` (the test profile) used positional seed inserts, so I appended a `NULL` to its 10 `owners` rows; h2/postgres/mysql use explicit column lists and needed no data edits.

I kept the touched functions simple: `BuildOwner` gained one branch in a single-method class (WMC_other = 0), and the entity only received a trivial getter/setter pair rather than growing any existing method.

The two new acceptance tests (`coreDefaultsToToday`, `functionalityKeepsSuppliedDate`) and the full suite are green.
